answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by the non-revertible security patch, despite memory_b1. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails fast and would drop settlement writes, which violates the no-lost-writes objective. The symptom is write-path saturation at daily peak, so the closest prior fix is provisioning headroom (memory_b3). Read-replica offload (memory_b5) recovered write latency only when report queries were the extra load; that is unverified here and replicas cannot absorb settlement writes. Failover is unindicated without a regional fault and risks in-flight writes. Intend add_capacity at standard—not a tiny canary, not a fleet-wide leap—while verifying b3 and b5. Root cause remains uncertain.
